Mara: Quick thread — new hook for the benchmark push: 'tail-econ' storytelling. Goal: show which serving configs are cost-efficient while meeting 99th-ms SLAs. Avoid mean-latency charts, focus on actionable tradeoffs.

Devin: Yes. Teams want to know if the tail holds under peak. Mean hides the worst-case.

Sam: Design ask: three panels
1) Tail compliance curve: P(99th <= X ms) vs $/1M tokens, one line per config
2) Cost waterfall for 100k reqs (batching, cache, model compute, infra)
3) Quick-play grid: recommended knob per persona (chat/search/embeds)

Leah: Can someone drop a tiny CSV so designers can mock with real points?

Mara: Dropping small CSV + cost ticks (use these to plot):
```
latency_ms,baseline,batched_opt,cache_first
140,0.55,0.80,0.95
190,0.72,0.92,0.988
240,0.86,0.975,0.997
290,0.94,0.994,0.9996
```
Costs per 1M tokens (USD): baseline=1400,batched_opt=820,cache_first=410
```
config,cost_per_1M
baseline,1400
batched_opt,820
cache_first,410
```

Priya: Hero copy variants (pick one):
A) "Tail-econ: predictable 99th latency with clear unit costs"
B) "Protect your SLAs and cut inference spend up to 3x"
C) "SLA-first inference: the knobs that move tail and cost"

Sam: My vote is C for product docs, B for paid channels.

Leah: Webinar hook: 25-min live demo — 15 demo + 10 Q&A. Flow: run baseline under synthetic load -> flip to batched_opt -> enable cache_first -> show 99th traces and cost delta. Record a 3-min highlight for LP. We'll annotate flip events on the traces.

Devin: Eng can provide a reproducible traffic script and emit 99th every 10s. We'll annotate the routing flip. ETA 72 hours for a recording-ready run.

Tom: Lead routing notes: tag engaged users with ["lead:tail-econ","lead:unit-cost","lead:embeddings-use"]. Nurture path: one-pager -> 3-min clip -> sales config templates.

Mara: Action items:
- Design (Sam): mock the 3 panels from CSV by EOD Thursday
- Eng (Devin): traffic script + annotated trace + 3-min clip in 3 days
- Content (Priya): one-pager + webinar script; lock hero by Friday
- Growth (Tom): wire tags and LP funnel

Sam: Draft CTA for one-pager: "Watch the 3-minute demo: see the tail, cut the spend."

marketing-bot: Sprint created: "tail-econ-benchmark" due in 9 days. :rocket:
